title: Remove redundant gofmt from Makefile
overview:
Redundant formatting command wastes CI time.

**Motivation:** Simplifies Makefile and removes redundant operation.

**Technical constraints:**
- Remove 'gofmt -w .' line from Makefile as goimports handles both imports and formatting

**Signals:** priority: medium
problem_statement: Redundant formatting command wastes CI time.
motivation: Simplifies Makefile and removes redundant operation.
technical_constraints: Remove 'gofmt -w .' line from Makefile as goimports handles both imports and formatting
resolution_notes: The Makefile does not contain gofmt. It only uses goimports which handles both imports and formatting. This was a false positive from the original codebase analysis.
